postprocessing: None. PNG outputs copied byte for byte into this project; no image manipulation or resizing.
purpose: Three social episodes requested for the Edition 05 upgrade; all arrangements and architecture are proposed worldbuilding.

inspection.observations: Three equal panels with the same identifiable protagonist, teal shirt and orange bag. Private breakfast and closed door; generous provision hall, routine robot arms, an older neighbor with wheelchair; instrument library and telescope. No visible payment or membership gate. Faces and tactile interactions clear.
inspection.interpretation: Durable provision and the freedom to change commitments are proposed institutions supplied by the atlas copy; the image itself depicts ordinary access, rest and chosen inquiry.

inspection.observations: Three equal panels in a recurring canal-arch room. Same established blue- and green-cloaked guild members and rust-clad newcomer. The newcomer first watches beyond the concentrated board, then participates in rearrangement, then places a small bridge among shared blue routes. Tower and ship model recur; earlier participants remain included.
inspection.interpretation: Tactile layout communicates participation and authorship; the precise proposed change from victory-controlled authoring/rehearsal slots to newcomer trial opportunities is specified in the atlas copy. No necessities are shown as prizes.

inspection.observations: Embodied foreground invitation into music and dance; adults, including a wheelchair participant, move on a real floor. Warm curved ribbed hall and violet fabric lighting give a distinct atmosphere. A person rests alone in a right-hand alcove. Discreet cart and integrated lighting support the place. Fully clothed adults and no performance scores.
inspection.interpretation: Architecture and sensory systems are concept proposals; image depicts expression and rest as sufficient ways to inhabit the commons without assigning productive purpose.
